name: Hong Kong: unincorporated businesses
dueNote: There is no VAT or GST. Profits tax is assessed yearly with provisional tax; the rest of a year's reserve is released one year after it ends.

presets.label: No VAT + profits tax reserve 15% (two-tier: 7.5% then 15%)

buckets.name: profits_tax

items.name: mpf

notes: Only profits sourced in Hong Kong are taxed.
